title: RecursivePlanTree
description: A type-driven recursive plan-decomposition tree with a provable termination bound, per-node contracts, defeater-justified fallbacks, and SPOF tagging. Validated by plan_validator.py. This schema describes STRUCTURE; the validator enforces the SEMANTIC obligations (ranking strictly decreases parent->child OR depth within depth_cap; leaves carry acceptance tests; every node has pre+postconditions; every node has a defeater-justified fallback OR is SPOF-tagged with a reason; children postconditions cover the parent's; no cycles; no SPOF-with-no-fallback on a root->leaf path).

root.description: node id of the single root

ranking_name.description: name of the well-founded ranking function whose value must strictly decrease parent->child (termination proof obligation)

depth_cap.description: global circuit-breaker depth bound; a non-leaf edge that does NOT strictly decrease the ranking is only allowed if both nodes are within this depth

type.description: node type; the TYPE drives the decomposition arity (type-driven arity, not a fixed binary split)

arity.description: number of children this node's type decomposes into; 0 for a leaf; must equal len(children)

parent.description: parent node id, or null for the root

ranking_value.description: value of the named ranking function at this node; must strictly decrease from parent to each child unless the depth_cap clause applies

postconditions.description: postcondition contract tags; a parent's postconditions must be covered by the union of its children's postconditions (contract composition)

trigger.description: the defeater/trigger condition that activates this fallback (defeater-justified, not blanket)
